record.text: 战吼：抽一张延系牌以及另一张可以激活其效果的牌。
record.text_en: Battlecry: Draw a Kindred card and another card that activates it.

policies: Torga draws one original physical currently printed native Kindred face, followed by a second current physical deck draw with the same printed minion-type or spell-school relation used by native Kindred. It does not play either card or prime Kindred. Complete multi-tribe/all metadata is required, not a primary-type/name shortcut.

The first DrawRecord retains the original Kindred face through burns, replacement draws, hand departure or transformation. The second selector runs after the first original draw/reactions; nested draws do not become the first root. No first or second match skips the corresponding tutor without fatigue. Printed current-face versus removed keyword/ability policy remains local M6.

Twisted Monstrosity has the actual printed Taunt/Elusive pair from raw DYNAMIC_KEYWORD tags. While physically held, an original friendly turn_started hand-progress event replaces the two printed keyword slots by two distinct choices from the complete8 constructed BONUS_EFFECTS, including Rush. External grants are preserved. This is a printed-slot swap, not the board grant/readiness filter.

Initial acquisition uses the printed pair without a speculative extra roll; original own-turn starts rotate while held, not deck/board or opponent starts. Current copies preserve current slots, ordinary entry/reset and consumption use existing lifecycle. Exact acquisition/start/re-entry policies remain explicit local M6 awaiting CN calibration.

Living Plague and Nythendra remain unregistered/unimplemented in this packet; their full official roots/children are retained in source review, not treated as blank cards or removed from any generator inventory. Original four-card dependency objective and full Standard goal are unchanged. No partial executable generation pool opened.
